changelog: Adds context-aware reports for the ShadowMountPlus HTTP API listener becoming unresponsive and scans remaining queued after game exit.
Adds official ShadowMountPlus 1.7beta5 runtime guidance; release notes are not treated as proof of a specific crash cause.
Updates TitleDir and ShellCore hook guidance for the 1.7beta5 automatic hook-recovery notes.
Retains the open state of issue #153 and PR #163; the proposed sandbox timeout is not labelled as a released fix.
The updater downloads only the diagnostic knowledge-base JSON after explicit user confirmation; no logs or console details are uploaded.

privacy.downloads: Only the diagnostic knowledge-base JSON is downloaded after user confirmation.
privacy.uploads: No logs, reports, console IP addresses, or personal data are uploaded by the updater.
